exposure: conventional care with kangaroo mother care initiated after stabilization
outcome: death in the neonatal period (first 28 days of life)
death in the first 72 hours of life
cohort: The study participants were 3211 infants with a birth weight between 1.0 and 1.799 kg and their mothers.
finding: Among infants with a birth weight between 1.0 and 1.799 kg, those who received immediate kangaroo mother care had lower mortality at 28 days than those who received conventional care with kangaroo mother care initiated after stabilization.
